name: Watashi o Golf ni Tsuretette
original_name: 私をゴルフに連れてって
source:
Can you impress of one fifteen girls with your superior golf skills? She may be very happy about it.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-month-march-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
你能憑藉高超的高爾夫球技，打動十五位女孩中的某一位嗎？她或許會因此喜出望外。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/05/vn-of-month-march-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
